Title: Azure Video Analyzer (preview) will be retired on 30 November 2022

Body.Content:
On 30 November 2022, Azure Video Analyzer preview will be retired. Before that date, please transition to Dynamics Connected Spaces or Open Source solutions. Dynamics Connected Spaces or Open Source solutions each provide unique video analyzing scenarios, please explore the two migration options and select the one which best meet your business needs.

From now through 30 November 2022, you can continue to use the Azure Video Analyzer in preview and work on migrating your application. Beginning 1 December 2022, your Azure Video Analyzer account will no longer function.

Required action  

Explore the two migration options and select the one which best meet your business needs before 30 November 2022.

Help and support 

If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request
